questions.question: God said he appeared to the patriarchs as God Almighty, but by what name was he not fully known to them?
What did God promise to do for Israel?
options: Bring them out of Egypt and be their God
Make their name greater than Pharaoh's own
Build them a great temple in the desert
Give them victory over the kings of Canaan
questions.answer: Bring them out of Egypt and be their God

questions.question: The Israelites listened eagerly to Moses despite their hard slavery.
God said, "I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a _____."
God said he had remembered his _____ with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
